svg.title: BOSS — primary lockup · /agentics proof-panel reframe
svg.desc: Panel-presentation variant of BOSS v2.3 lockup on the shared 600×210 proof-panel canvas (dispatch-084). Wordmark artwork (B + constellation-O + S + S) byte-identical to canonical boss-lockup.svg; only the canvas, the wrapping transform, and the uniform stone-rule + italic tagline change so the three /agentics proof-panel logos co-plane at wordmark cap-height 56 and cap-center y=80. Canonical brand file unchanged.
